entries.final_answer: charter resynthesize/synthesize --dry-run refuses a project's own activated project directive with the FR-020/EC-6 additive-only violation because SynthesisRequest.drg_snapshot mixes the built-in layer with the activated project directives. Reproduced on d75e0bc5; see spec.md Problem Statement.
entries.question: What problem does this Mission solve?

entries.final_answer: SC-001..SC-004 in spec.md: resynthesize of an activated project-authored directive exits 0; the genuine built-in collision still refuses (positive control on the same fixture); project tactic references still resolve while an undeclared URN still refuses; existing charter suites stay green with unchanged fixture keys.
